# Resetting your password

If you forgot your password, open the sign-in page and click "Forgot password".
We email you a password reset link that stays valid for 60 minutes.
Open the link, choose a new password of at least 12 characters, and sign in again.

If the reset email does not arrive, check your spam folder. Password reset
links can only be used once; request a new link if yours has expired.
